title: tc-filter-menu
description: Grouped filters: removable chips on top, collapsible groups of checkboxes below.

groups.description: The filter groups, in order – each a collapsible list of options that become chips when picked

value.description: The picked options, per group id

open.description: Ids of the open groups – unset opens the first group

name.description: Name for native form submission: one hidden input per picked option, named `name[groupId]`

disabled.description: Nothing can be picked, removed or cleared, and the hidden inputs are left out of the form

heading.description: The heading, next to Clear all

hints.description: Show the keyboard hints at the bottom (Clean: as the last row of the card); hints="false" hides them

chipPrefix.description: Put in front of the option on its chip, e.g. "Score: " → "Score: 80–90"
